questions.prompt: Which relation lifecycle event is triggered on a charm unit whenever the remote application updates data in its databag?
questions.explanation: 'relation-changed' fires whenever new or updated key-value data is written by the remote relation participant.

questions.prompt: What are the two scopes of relation databags in Juju?
questions.explanation: Relation databags are partitioned into Application-level data and Unit-specific data.

questions.prompt: Which event fires on all participating units when an integration is completely severed?
questions.explanation: 'relation-broken' signals that the relation between the applications no longer exists.
